bio.text: Kimberly Overman is the Democratic candidate for Florida's 12th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served on the Hillsborough County Board of Commissioners (District 7, at-large) from 2018 to 2022.
She was born in New York City and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland in 1981; her professional experience is in financial planning.
